capability.summary: Recursively map the nested folders and files below one local directory as a directory tree.
capability.description: Use to inspect hierarchical filesystem structure beneath a known root path, such as understanding a source tree or reporting nested folders. It traverses descendants for structure; it does not search file text, read a file's contents, or mutate the workspace.
capability.problem_space: Inspect the recursive hierarchy below a local root directory and return an ordered tree of nested paths. This is for structural discovery, distinct from a one-level directory listing, filename/content pattern search, file-content reading, and filesystem mutation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one local root directory path. Output: JSON representation of the recursive directory tree below that root.
accepted_inputs: an existing local directory path within the tool's allowed filesystem roots
constraint.output_shape: JSON hierarchical tree of descendant directories and files.
limitations: does not search file names or file contents by a pattern
does not read file contents or modify files and directories

output_contract.description: Recursive directory tree via MCP filesystem server

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: search files by name or content pattern
